After the deposit, they unexpectedly sent me to another clinic near Nimmanhaemin, which I didn't know anything about, had no reviews, and was practically inactive on their page. They didn't inform me of this beforehand; I was told to come and discuss things in person. Ultimately, the 14,999 THB course increased to 147,999 THB, and they recommended a repair procedure for an additional 50,000 THB, bringing the total to 197,999 THB. They claimed to have a Bangkok branch, but the clinic said they didn't know this one. The staff were inexperienced and gave incorrect information, making it extremely unreliable and causing me to be afraid to undergo surgery. Finally, when I requested a refund, they refused, saying the company has no refund policy.

text: I got 2cc of chin filler at this clinic. The salesperson recommended two brands: the black box and the gold box. I asked about the difference, and they explained that the gold box was better, shaped better, and lasted longer. On the day of the injection, the doctor showed me the black box to scan. I was confused because I had purchased the gold box (2cc) for 15,000 baht. I asked the doctor why I hadn't bought the gold box, and she said she needed to check with the salesperson outside. Then, the salesperson who sold me the filler said I should get the black box because it shaped better. It was ridiculous; they said one thing during the sales pitch and another during the injection. I paid more for the gold box than the black box. Ultimately, I got the black box. (However, I really liked the doctor here; they were honest with customers, advised on the appropriate cc, and were very polite. But I disliked one of the salespeople who sold me the filler; they lacked sincerity. Before going to this clinic, I researched it thoroughly because it looked luxurious, modern, and trustworthy. But this salesperson was very unacceptable and dishonest. I'm no longer interested in doing other procedures here because of the salesperson's lack of honesty. text:
I've had liposuction twice a few months ago, and the results have been satisfactory. The quality matches the price; my measurements have definitely decreased, and significantly so. However, my arms look strange, not as slender as they should be. I had to get revisions done at another clinic.
The price quoted wasn't final; there were additional charges on-site, including blood tests and medication for 3,500 baht. I was very unhappy about this, so I only paid for the blood tests and didn't take the medication. They were understanding and gave me whatever medication they could offer.
I was very impressed with the nursing staff; they were very attentive and patient until the bleeding stopped.
However, the scheduling process needs significant improvement. I had an appointment at 1 PM, but I had to wait until almost 7 PM.
Both times I had liposuction, the wait times were extremely long, often 5-6 hours late. This would be very inconvenient for people coming from out of town.
